announcements.text: 6 Oct 2026, 00:00 UTC: funded trade minimum hold changes from 120s to 60s for challenges purchased from this date. Older purchases/resets remain 120s; evaluation is excluded.
FundingPips announced removal of subjective rules. Historical announcement, not a waiver of current prohibited-trading policies.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: subjective rules removal announced
announcements.appliesTo: FundingPips evaluation models; current account agreement still applies.

announcements.text: Announcement concerns evaluation risk restrictions, not daily drawdown or maximum-loss limits. It is not a removal of all trading rules.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: evaluation risk restrictions removed
announcements.appliesTo: Evaluation stage only; not Zero or Master-account risk controls.

announcements.text: The announcement explicitly includes Standard 8%/5% accounts. Legacy 10%-target accounts have size-dependent rules; do not treat all Standard accounts alike.
announcements.title: 26 Jul 2026: per-trade hard-breach removal
announcements.appliesTo: 2-Step Standard 8%/5% model only; check purchase cohort and agreement.

announcements.text: 28 Sep 2026 rulebook change: purchases before this date use legacy rules; new purchases/resets use the new rulebook. Check your account cohort.
Stellar scale-up update: purchases/resets before 12 Jan 2026 retain the previous plan; those after the date follow the new plan.
From Feb 2026: Express 1-Step, Classic 2-Step and Instant start swap-free automatically; older legacy programs are excluded.
